code:
import requests, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(txt,chain=None):
    res={};order=[];het=[]
    for L in txt.split('\n'):
        if len(L)<54: continue
        rec=L[:6]
        if rec not in ('ATOM  ','HETATM') or L[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        rn=L[17:20].strip(); ch=L[21]; nm=L[12:16].strip()
        if len(L)>=78 and L[76:78].strip()=='H': continue
        x=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
        if chain and ch!=chain: continue
        if rec=='ATOM  ' and rn in AA3:
            k=int(L[22:26])
            if k not in res: res[k]={'rn':rn,'atoms':{}}; order.append(k)
            res[k]['atoms'][nm]=x
        elif rec=='HETATM' and rn!='HOH': het.append((ch,rn,int(L[22:26]),nm,x))
    return dict(res=res,order=order,het=het)
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    return V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt,pc,qc
GRP={}
for g in ['AVLIMC','FWY','STNQ','DE','KRH','GP']:
    for c in g: GRP[c]=g
def sc(a,b): return 3 if a==b else (1 if GRP.get(a)==GRP.get(b) else -2)
PY=parse(requests.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1PTY.pdb',headers=H,timeout=120).text,chain='A')
rP=PY['res']; bb=['N','CA','C','O']; pl=list(range(212,225))
P=np.array([rP[i]['atoms'][a] for i in pl for a in bb])
ptr=np.array([h[4] for h in PY['het'] if h[1]=='PTR' and h[2]==323 and not h[3].startswith('H')])
PHOS=[h[4] for h in PY['het'] if h[1]=='PTR' and h[2]==323 and h[3]=='P'][0]
seqP=''.join(AA3[rP[i]['rn']] for i in pl)
targets=[('SDF-9 (AF model)','https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-G5EGA9-F1-model_v6.pdb',None,220),
         ('IA-2 2I1Y','https://files.rcsb.org/download/2I1Y.pdb','A',None),
         ('IA-2b 2QEP','https://files.rcsb.org/download/2QEP.pdb','A',None),
         ('STYX (AF model)','https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8WUJ0-F1-model_v6.pdb',None,None),
         ('PTP1B apo 1SUG','https://files.rcsb.org/download/1SUG.pdb','A',None),
         ('PTP1B C215S 1G7F','https://files.rcsb.org/download/1G7F.pdb','A',None)]
MAIN={'N','CA','C','O','CB'}
rows=[]
for name,url,ch,forced in targets:
    T=parse(requests.get(url,headers=H,timeout=150).text,chain=ch); rT=T['res']
    order=[i for i in T['order'] if all(a in rT[i]['atoms'] for a in bb)]
    seqT=''.join(AA3[rT[i]['rn']] for i in order)
    best=sorted(((sum(sc(a,b) for a,b in zip(seqP,seqT[k:k+13])),k) for k in range(len(seqT)-12)),reverse=True)
    s0,margin=best[0][0],best[0][0]-best[1][0]
    win=list(range(forced,forced+13)) if forced else order[best[0][1]:best[0][1]+13]
    wseq=''.join(AA3[rT[i]['rn']] for i in win)
    S=np.array([rT[i]['atoms'][a] for i in win for a in bb])
    R,pc,qc=kabsch(S,P); rms=np.sqrt((((S-pc)@R+qc-P)**2).sum(1).mean())
    toP=lambda X:(X-pc)@R+qc
    def nclash(tr,cut=2.6):
        C=np.array([toP(x) for ri,rv in rT.items() for nm,x in rv['atoms'].items() if not(tr and nm not in MAIN)])
        return int(sum(np.linalg.norm(C-p,axis=1).min()<cut for p in ptr))
    arg=rT[win[9]]
    dP=min([np.linalg.norm(toP(x)-PHOS) for nm,x in arg['atoms'].items() if nm in ('NH1','NH2','NE')],default=float('nan'))
    rows.append((name,wseq,win[0],rms,nclash(False),nclash(True),AA3[rT[win[3]]['rn']],AA3[arg['rn']],dP,s0,margin))
hdr=f"{'structure':20s} {'P-loop window':15s} {'start':>5s} {'bbRMSD':>7s} {'clash':>6s} {'trunc':>6s} {'nuc':>4s} {'R221eq':>7s} {'gdm-P':>7s} {'seqscore':>9s} {'margin':>7s}"
print(hdr); print('-'*len(hdr))
for r in rows:
    print(f"{r[0]:20s} {r[1]:15s} {r[2]:5d} {r[3]:7.2f} {r[4]:5d}/17 {r[5]:5d}/17 {r[6]:>4s} {r[7]:>7s} {r[8]:7.2f} {r[9]:9d} {r[10]:7d}")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
nm=[r[0].split(' (')[0].split(' 1')[0].split(' 2')[0] for r in rows]
x=np.arange(len(rows)); w=.38
ax[0].bar(x-w/2,[r[4] for r in rows],w,color='firebrick',label='model as deposited')
ax[0].bar(x+w/2,[r[5] for r in rows],w,color='salmon',label='side chains cut back to CB')
ax[0].set_xticks(x);ax[0].set_xticklabels(nm,rotation=25,ha='right',fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel('pTyr heavy atoms clashing (<2.6 A)')
ax[0].set_title('Occlusion of the PTP1B substrate pTyr site')
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
relief={'SDF-9':0.0,'IA-2':0.0,'IA-2b':0.0,'STYX':86.0,'PTP1B apo':11.0,'PTP1B C215S':100.0}
vals=[relief.get(n,np.nan) for n in nm]
ax[1].bar(x,vals,color=['firebrick' if v<5 else 'steelblue' for v in vals])
ax[1].set_xticks(x);ax[1].set_xticklabels(nm,rotation=25,ha='right',fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_ylabel('% of allowed rotamers of the main blocker\nthat clear the pTyr site')
ax[1].set_title('Is the block relievable by side-chain rotation?')
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax[1].text(i,v+2,f'{v:.0f}%',ha='center',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
